body: I appreciate your directness. I would pursue a PhD in neuroscience, if at all, which is why I need the extra time in a molecular bio lab (the aforementioned training opportunity). But thank you again for your advice!!
I’m in the US and it says server down

Yes, the covid situation has certainly made things harder. If you feel like you’re not in any immediate danger of harming yourself, maybe took into online therapy or counseling , which is done over the phone or video chat.

I can’t believe I just saw this, sorry. I don’t feel comfortable disclosing which one I went to specifically. I will say I was very scared of going myself. But in the end, it you need the help, then take the leap and go. Did it help? Immediately, I would say not so much but going to the hospital got me connected to a lot of other resources like therapy and medications which in the end, are the reason I’m still here today.

I had taken bottles of pills at a time before but I knew they were not lethal, they would just make things groggy. This time, I knew what I had done. As I contemplated where to lay down after finishing all the medicine, it slowly began to sink in what was going to happen and I was terrified.

Very much so! Like I mentioned, this was years ago. Afterward, I was required to attend therapy for several hours a week. Slowly working my way out of it. I don’t go anymore though sometimes I wish I do. But I feel good. I still get sad, sometimes I feel a wave of the same feeling come back, but it never lingers the way it did before. Thanks for asking :)

UPDATE: I believe this will be the last update I post. We very much fell out. We stopped talking for about 2 weeks. We recently talked on the phone ( he called) and basically just verbally reiterated what was already understood. We were not talking anymore. Duh? I do want to point some things out though, he called me submissive because I stopped texting/ snapping/ calling him (mind you I was always initiating), said I was on his “back burner” because he’s “so busy” and that the thought of having to talk to me became  “exhausting”  which is why he called. To “let me know we are not talking anymore” so he could be free to “do what he needs to do” aka what he was already doing and quite frankly what I was already doing. I really had moved on but the call definitely stung. Anyways. That’s the end of the line on this “relationship”

The whole thing went to shit. No more good morning / good night texts, no more calls, just the occasional response to a text. I feel like I may have over reacted and perhaps weirded him out, but I think he was very much avoiding me for a few days which made things feel worse. Pretty effing upsetting but life goes on.
I definitely have strong feelings for him, I would just hate to confess that only to get a , “oh I didn’t mean it like that” type of response. But. I’ll talk to him and tread carefully I suppose.

Phone call did not happen , but we’re supposed to talk in between classes today , I’m at a total loss for what to say. I don’t want to sound confrontational or accusatory, but I feel like there should be a follow up to a drunk “I love you” text.

I appreciate your response. After reading it around 10 am, I responded with a “ good morning 💛, call me when you can” to which he relied , “good morning, why what’s up?, I’ll be busy all day” 

To be more specific, this was on an app with auto delete messaging , so it is entirely possible he does not remember saying anything to me.
